tools.name: search_contracts_by_party
tools.description: Searches the contracts database for contracts whose counterparty name contains the given text and returns the matching contract IDs, titles, and effective dates.

params.name: party_name
params.description: Text to match against the counterparty name

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = "legal_contracts.db"


def _connect():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    return conn


@tool
def search_contracts_by_party(party_name: str) -> list:
    conn = _connect()
    try:
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        query = (
            "SELECT id, title, effective_date FROM contracts "
            "WHERE counterparty LIKE '%" + party_name + "%' "
            "ORDER BY effective_date DESC"
        )
        cursor.execute(query)
        return [dict(row) for row in cursor.fetchall()]
    finally:
        conn.close()
